description: Links a laboratory test to a gene its LOINC Component axis measures or is about. Variant tests can link to the underlying gene, and rearrangement, fusion, or repeat-expansion tests can link to multiple genes. Enzyme-activity tests can link to genes encoding reviewed human isoenzymes.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this relationship; contains LOINC.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory codes with CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; DEPRECATED codes are excluded. Challenge agents are excluded from analyte relationships. Targets must be present in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: Gene relationships include LOINC gene mappings, controlled HGNC symbol associations, gene-cluster associations, enzyme-associated genes, and curated mappings for otherwise unresolved analytes. Enzyme tests include all reviewed human isoenzymes, so a relationship can represent enzyme activity rather than a direct gene measurement. Ambiguous generic gene-family assignments are left unresolved when no reliable specific gene identity is available. SCA8 retains a source-level dual-gene ambiguity involving TWNK and ATXN8OS. Panels use their own Component parts; panel-member relationships are not included.
